author: opencode-worker-2
text: TIMEBOX-RELEASED by worker-2 (heft) with a hard blocker documented. State reached: the conversion was implemented (csma_cad/lichen_lora_perform_cca arm lichen_lora_cad_start with a stack cad_wait_ctx {k_sem done, bounded K_MSEC(timeout+100) take}; blocking lichen_lora_cad_run + lichen_lora_cad_fn + lichen_lora_cad_register + the four drivers' blocking cad impls deleted; NULL start = synchronous emulated clear-channel delivery). Build compiles+links and the hal suite passes, BUT ping_l2 panics deterministically at the first test: 'ASSERTION FAIL [z_spin_lock_valid] Invalid spinlock 0x44ae50' on the SYSTEM WORKQUEUE thread - a k_spin_lock on a spinlock address not in static data. Bisect-confirmed introduced by this conversion (HEAD without the diff: 4/7 clean, no panic; with the diff: panic; removing the loopback NULL-start registration did not help; simplifying the emulated delivery to synchronous did not help). Suspects for the next claimer: (a) a stack-allocated k_sem/k_spinlock reachable by the sysworkq through the cad_wait_ctx handoff, (b) the Zephyr spinlock validator's interaction with native_sim hosted threads, (c) something in the deleted lichen_lora_cad_run call graph that was pinning the sysworkq spinlock domain. Alternative framing: keep a blocking-callback variant for emulated drivers instead of NULL-start, or drive the whole CSMA acquire as a true continuation state machine (larger). The diff was reverted, not committed - do not assume partial progress in the tree. Suggest root-causing the sysworkq spinlock panic first (CONFIG_DEBUG_OPTIMIZATIONS + backtrace, or a minimal repro with lichen_lora_cad_start from a work item).
